name: Axiom Systems Data Exfiltration Wafer DEW-1
product_name: Axiom Systems Data Exfiltration Wafer DEW-1
description: A paper-thin flexible circuit that adheres to any data port and silently copies all data passing through the connection. The DEW-1 is smaller than a postage stamp and can be applied to a data port in under 2 seconds, where it sits flush against the connector housing and is virtually undetectable without physical inspection. The wafer copies all data traffic bidirectionally — incoming and outgoing — to an encrypted micro-storage module that can be retrieved later, or transmits captured data via low-power burst to a nearby receiver. A single wafer can operate for 6 months on its integrated battery, silently capturing every byte that passes through its host port.
story_hooks: A routine IT maintenance check discovered a DEW-1 on a server room data port that had been capturing traffic for four months — the storage module contained complete copies of every transaction, communication, and security log.
A DEW-1 was found on the neural interface charging port of an executive's desk — it had been copying their neural interface backup data every night for three months.

physical_description.visual_profile: An ultra-thin, translucent circuit wafer with a barely-visible iridescent sheen. Paper-thin and flexible, it appears almost like a holographic film or security label at first glance. The surface is dominated by microscopic trace patterns visible only under magnification, with faint silver circuitry barely perceptible against a near-transparent substrate. One edge features a discrete adhesive strip that's slightly raised.
physical_description.weight_description: Negligible — pocketable, would barely register on a precision scale. Can be carried loose or in a protective sleeve.
physical_description.primary_material: Flexible graphene-composite substrate with embedded nanoscale circuitry
physical_description.finish: Matte translucent with subtle holographic interference patterns; adhesive backing has faint micro-grip texture
physical_description.color_scheme: Nearly colorless/transparent with ghost-white circuitry traces; faint blue-violet undertones from the data-active micro-capacitors when powered
physical_description.interface_elements: No visible user interface. Two microscopic contact points on one edge serve as the data tap. The adhesive strip has a release tab (translucent polymer). A pinhead-sized indicator LED near the corner pulses faintly blue when active (difficult to notice unless deliberately observed).
distinctive_features: Hairline circuit traces forming a minimal geometric pattern visible only at oblique angles
Barely-perceptible adhesive strip edge with release tab
Micro-pinhole transmission antenna barely visible as a slight surface dimple
Faint blue micro-LED that pulses every 3 seconds during active data capture
Holographic security shimmer that shifts from violet to cyan depending on viewing angle
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: AXIOM SYSTEMS etched in 1mm text on one corner in chrome-silver ink; DEW-1 model designation; Φ price marking (typically 2,400-3,100 QUANTA); regulatory compliance stamp (micro-text: GLMZ Tier 3+ Authorization)
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when new; after deployment on a port, virtually invisible flush against connector housing. Dust and port residue may collect around edges after 2-3 months of operation.
